# Schools & Team Rosters
Explore NAIA women's wrestling programs, team national achievements, and complete athlete rosters across all championship seasons.
:::
<img src="naia_logo.png" alt="NAIA Logo" class="hero-logo-img">
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)

# Read datasets
athletes <- read_csv("data/athletes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  arrange(team, weight_class, desc(points_scored), name)

programs <- read_csv("data/naia_women_programs.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Clean school names from programs for matching
programs_clean <- programs |>
  mutate(clean_team = str_remove_all(school, " (University|College)$") |>
           str_remove("^University of (the )?") |>
           str_remove("^The "))

# Program lookup dictionary for state, city, conference
program_lookup <- programs_clean |>
  select(clean_team, city, state, conference) |>
  distinct()

# Edge case corrections for older or alternatively-named institutions
special_cases <- tibble(
  clean_team = c("Menlo", "Vanguard", "Evergreen State", "Evergreen", "Iowa Wesleyan",
                 "St. Mary", "Saint Mary", "Brewton Parker", "Brewton-Parker",
                 "Jarvis Christian", "St. Andrews", "St Andrews"),
  city = c("Atherton", "Costa Mesa", "Olympia", "Olympia", "Mount Pleasant",
           "Leavenworth", "Leavenworth", "Mount Vernon", "Mount Vernon",
           "Hawkins", "Laurinburg", "Laurinburg"),
  state = c("CA", "CA", "WA", "WA", "IA", "KS", "KS", "GA", "GA", "TX", "NC", "NC"),
  conference = c("Cascade / Independent", "Cascade Collegiate Conference", "Cascade Collegiate Conference",
                 "Cascade Collegiate Conference", "Heart of America", "KCAC / SAC", "KCAC / SAC",
                 "Mid-South Conference", "Mid-South Conference", "KCAC / SAC",
                 "Mid-South Conference", "Mid-South Conference")
)

all_lookups <- bind_rows(program_lookup, special_cases) |>
  distinct(clean_team, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Calculate summary stats per school
school_summary <- athletes |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarize(
    total_qualifiers = n(),
    all_americans = sum(place %in% c("1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th", "5th", "6th", "7th", "8th", "1st Place", "2nd Place")),
    national_champions = sum(place %in% c("1st", "1st Place")),
    total_points = sum(points_scored, na.rm = TRUE),
    seasons_list = paste(sort(unique(season), decreasing = TRUE), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(all_lookups, by = c("team" = "clean_team")) |>
  mutate(
    city = coalesce(city, "—"),
    state = coalesce(state, "—"),
    conference = coalesce(conference, "NAIA Independent"),
    location = ifelse(city != "—" & state != "—", paste0(city, ", ", state), "—")
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(all_americans), desc(total_points), team)

# Overall summary statistics for top cards
total_schools <- nrow(school_summary)
total_athletes <- nrow(athletes)
total_aas <- sum(school_summary$all_americans)
total_confs <- length(unique(school_summary$conference[school_summary$conference != "NAIA Independent"]))

HTML(paste0(
  '<div class="stats-grid">',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">', total_schools, '</div><div class="stat-label">Programs Represented</div></div>',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">', total_confs, '</div><div class="stat-label">Active Conferences</div></div>',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">', total_athletes, '</div><div class="stat-label">Championship Wrestlers</div></div>',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">', total_aas, '</div><div class="stat-label">All-Americans (Top 8)</div></div>',
  '</div>'
))
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## 🏫 NAIA Schools Directory

Explore collegiate programs that have competed in the NAIA Women's Wrestling National Championships. Use the search bar or conference filter to quickly find any school, or click **"View Roster"** to inspect its full roster and wrestler records.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

conferences <- sort(unique(school_summary$conference))
conf_options_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<option value="%s">%s</option>', conferences, conferences),
  collapse = ""
)

school_rows_html <- paste(
  sprintf(
    '<tr data-school="%s" data-conf="%s" data-state="%s">
      <td style="font-weight: 700; color: #1e3a8a; font-size: 1rem;">%s</td>
      <td><span class="badge-weight" style="font-weight: 500;">%s</span></td>
      <td style="color: #475569;">%s</td>
      <td style="text-align: center; font-weight: 600;">%d</td>
      <td style="text-align: center;">%s</td>
      <td style="text-align: right; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">%.1f</td>
      <td style="text-align: center; color: #64748b; font-size: 0.85rem;">%s</td>
      <td style="text-align: center;">
        <button type="button" class="btn-roster-link" onclick="viewSchoolRoster(\'%s\')">View Roster →</button>
      </td>
    </tr>',
    tolower(school_summary$team),
    school_summary$conference,
    school_summary$state,
    school_summary$team,
    school_summary$conference,
    school_summary$location,
    school_summary$total_qualifiers,
    ifelse(
      school_summary$national_champions > 0,
      sprintf('<span class="badge-gold">🏆 %d Champ%s</span> <span class="badge-place">%d AA%s</span>',
              school_summary$national_champions, ifelse(school_summary$national_champions > 1, "s", ""),
              school_summary$all_americans, ifelse(school_summary$all_americans > 1, "s", "")),
      ifelse(
        school_summary$all_americans > 0,
        sprintf('<span class="badge-place">%d All-American%s</span>',
                school_summary$all_americans, ifelse(school_summary$all_americans > 1, "s", "")),
        '<span style="color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.85rem;">—</span>'
      )
    ),
    school_summary$total_points,
    school_summary$seasons_list,
    gsub("'", "\\\\'", school_summary$team)
  ),
  collapse = ""
)

HTML(paste0(
  '<style>
  .btn-roster-link {
    background-color: #eff6ff;
    color: #1d4ed8;
    border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s ease-in-out;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .btn-roster-link:hover {
    background-color: #1d4ed8;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: #1d4ed8;
  }
  </style>',
  '<div class="filter-card">',
  '  <div style="display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end;">',
  '    <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 250px;">',
  '      <label for="schoolSearchInput">Search Schools</label>',
  '      <input type="text" id="schoolSearchInput" class="form-control" style="padding: 0.45rem 0.75rem;" placeholder="Search school name, city, state..." onkeyup="filterSchoolsDirectory()">',
  '    </div>',
  '    <div style="min-width: 240px;">',
  '      <label for="conferenceFilterSelect">Conference</label>',
  '      <select id="conferenceFilterSelect" class="form-select" style="padding: 0.45rem;" onchange="filterSchoolsDirectory()">',
  '        <option value="all">All Conferences</option>',
  conf_options_html,
  '      </select>',
  '    </div>',
  '  </div>',
  '  <div id="schoolDirectoryCount" style="margin-top: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #475569;">Showing all ', total_schools, ' NAIA programs</div>',
  '</div>',
  '<div class="table-wrapper">',
  '<table id="schoolsDirectoryTable" class="table table-hover">',
  '<thead>',
  '  <tr>',
  '    <th>School</th>',
  '    <th>Conference</th>',
  '    <th>Location</th>',
  '    <th style="text-align: center;">Qualifiers</th>',
  '    <th style="text-align: center;">All-Americans</th>',
  '    <th style="text-align: right;">Total Points</th>',
  '    <th style="text-align: center;">Seasons</th>',
  '    <th style="text-align: center;">Roster</th>',
  '  </tr>',
  '</thead>',
  '<tbody>', school_rows_html, '</tbody>',
  '</table>',
  '</div>',
  '<script>',
  'function filterSchoolsDirectory() {',
  '  const search = document.getElementById("schoolSearchInput").value.toLowerCase().trim();',
  '  const conf = document.getElementById("conferenceFilterSelect").value;',
  '  const rows = document.querySelectorAll("#schoolsDirectoryTable tbody tr");',
  '  let count = 0;',
  '  rows.forEach(row => {',
  '    const text = row.textContent.toLowerCase();',
  '    const rowConf = row.getAttribute("data-conf");',
  '    const matchSearch = (search === "" || text.includes(search));',
  '    const matchConf = (conf === "all" || rowConf === conf);',
  '    if (matchSearch && matchConf) {',
  '      row.style.display = "";',
  '      count++;',
  '    } else {',
  '      row.style.display = "none";',
  '    }',
  '  });',
  '  const countEl = document.getElementById("schoolDirectoryCount");',
  '  if (countEl) {',
  '    countEl.textContent = (conf === "all" && search === "") ?',
  '      ("Showing all " + count + " NAIA programs") :',
  '      ("Showing " + count + " matching programs");',
  '  }',
  '}',
  'function viewSchoolRoster(teamName) {',
  '  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll(".panel-tabset .nav-link, .panel-tabset [role=\"tab\"]");',
  '  if (tabs.length >= 2) {',
  '    tabs[1].click();',
  '  }',
  '  setTimeout(() => {',
  '    const select = document.getElementById("schoolSelect");',
  '    if (select) {',
  '      select.value = teamName;',
  '      filterSchoolRoster();',
  '    }',
  '    const rTable = document.getElementById("schoolRosterTable");',
  '    if (rTable) {',
  '      rTable.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });',
  '    }',
  '  }, 80);',
  '}',
  'makeTableSortable("schoolsDirectoryTable");',
  '</script>'
))
```

## 🤼 Athlete Rosters

Filter and search individual student-athlete records, national placements, and points scored by institution and championship year.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Helper function for place badges
get_place_badge <- function(place) {
  case_when(
    place %in% c("1st", "1st Place") ~ '<span class="badge-gold">🥇 1st Place</span>',
    place %in% c("2nd", "2nd Place") ~ '<span class="badge-silver">🥈 2nd Place</span>',
    place %in% c("3rd", "3rd Place") ~ '<span class="badge-bronze">🥉 3rd Place</span>',
    place %in% c("4th", "5th", "6th", "7th", "8th", "4th Place", "5th Place", "6th Place", "7th Place", "8th Place") ~ sprintf('<span class="badge-place">%s</span>', place),
    TRUE ~ '<span class="badge-dnp">—</span>'
  )
}

# Unique schools and seasons with rosters
schools <- sort(unique(athletes$team))
seasons <- sort(unique(athletes$season), decreasing = TRUE)

school_options_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<option value="%s">%s</option>', schools, schools),
  collapse = ""
)

season_options_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<option value="%s">%s</option>', seasons, seasons),
  collapse = ""
)

rows_html <- paste(
  sprintf(
    '<tr data-team="%s" data-season="%s">
      <td style="font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a;">%s</td>
      <td style="color: #334155; font-weight: 500;">%s</td>
      <td><span class="badge-weight">%s lbs</span></td>
      <td>%s</td>
      <td style="text-align: center; font-weight: 600;">%s</td>
      <td style="text-align: right; font-weight: 700; color: #1e3a8a;">%.1f</td>
      <td style="text-align: center;"><span class="badge-season">%s</span></td>
    </tr>',
    athletes$team, athletes$season, athletes$name, athletes$team, athletes$weight_class,
    get_place_badge(athletes$place), athletes$record, athletes$points_scored, athletes$season
  ),
  collapse = ""
)

HTML(paste0(
  '<div class="filter-card">',
  '  <div style="display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end;">',
  '    <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 220px;">',
  '      <label for="schoolSelect">Filter by School</label>',
  '      <select id="schoolSelect" class="form-select" style="padding: 0.45rem;" onchange="filterSchoolRoster()">',
  '        <option value="all">All Schools (', length(schools), ' Programs)</option>',
  school_options_html,
  '      </select>',
  '    </div>',
  '    <div style="min-width: 160px;">',
  '      <label for="seasonSelect">Championship Season</label>',
  '      <select id="seasonSelect" class="form-select" style="padding: 0.45rem;" onchange="filterSchoolRoster()">',
  '        <option value="all">All Seasons (2023–2026)</option>',
  season_options_html,
  '      </select>',
  '    </div>',
  '    <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 200px;">',
  '      <label for="wrestlerSearchInput">Search Wrestler</label>',
  '      <input type="text" id="wrestlerSearchInput" class="form-control" style="padding: 0.45rem 0.75rem;" placeholder="Search wrestler name..." onkeyup="filterSchoolRoster()">',
  '    </div>',
  '  </div>',
  '  <div id="schoolRosterCount" style="margin-top: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #475569;">Showing all ', nrow(athletes), ' wrestlers</div>',
  '</div>',
  '<div class="table-wrapper">',
  '<table id="schoolRosterTable" class="table table-hover">',
  '<thead>',
  '  <tr>',
  '    <th>Wrestler</th>',
  '    <th>School</th>',
  '    <th>Weight Class</th>',
  '    <th>Place</th>',
  '    <th style="text-align: center;">Record (W-L)</th>',
  '    <th style="text-align: right;">Points Scored</th>',
  '    <th style="text-align: center;">Season</th>',
  '  </tr>',
  '</thead>',
  '<tbody>', rows_html, '</tbody>',
  '</table>',
  '</div>',
  '<script>',
  'function filterSchoolRoster() {',
  '  const selectedTeam = document.getElementById("schoolSelect").value;',
  '  const selectedSeason = document.getElementById("seasonSelect").value;',
  '  const search = document.getElementById("wrestlerSearchInput") ? document.getElementById("wrestlerSearchInput").value.toLowerCase().trim() : "";',
  '  const rows = document.querySelectorAll("#schoolRosterTable tbody tr");',
  '  let count = 0;',
  '  rows.forEach(row => {',
  '    const matchTeam = (selectedTeam === "all" || row.getAttribute("data-team") === selectedTeam);',
  '    const matchSeason = (selectedSeason === "all" || row.getAttribute("data-season") === selectedSeason);',
  '    const nameCell = row.children[0].textContent.toLowerCase();',
  '    const matchSearch = (search === "" || nameCell.includes(search));',
  '    if (matchTeam && matchSeason && matchSearch) {',
  '      row.style.display = "";',
  '      count++;',
  '    } else {',
  '      row.style.display = "none";',
  '    }',
  '  });',
  '  const countEl = document.getElementById("schoolRosterCount");',
  '  if (countEl) {',
  '    let text = (selectedTeam === "all") ? ("Showing " + count + " wrestlers") : ("Showing " + count + " wrestlers for " + selectedTeam);',
  '    if (selectedSeason !== "all") text += " (" + selectedSeason + ")";',
  '    countEl.textContent = text;',
  '  }',
  '}',
  'function makeTableSortable(tableId) {',
  '  const table = document.getElementById(tableId);',
  '  if (!table) return;',
  '  const headers = table.querySelectorAll("thead th");',
  '  headers.forEach((th, colIdx) => {',
  '    th.style.cursor = "pointer";',
  '    th.title = "Click to sort";',
  '    th.setAttribute("data-title", th.textContent.trim());',
  '    th.textContent = th.getAttribute("data-title") + " ↕";',
  '    let asc = true;',
  '    th.addEventListener("click", () => {',
  '      const tbody = table.querySelector("tbody");',
  '      const rows = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll("tr"));',
  '      rows.sort((a, b) => {',
  '        const valA = a.children[colIdx].textContent.trim();',
  '        const valB = b.children[colIdx].textContent.trim();',
  '        const numA = parseFloat(valA);',
  '        const numB = parseFloat(valB);',
  '        if (!isNaN(numA) && !isNaN(numB)) {',
  '          return asc ? numA - numB : numB - numA;',
  '        }',
  '        return asc ? valA.localeCompare(valB) : valB.localeCompare(valA);',
  '      });',
  '      rows.forEach(r => tbody.appendChild(r));',
  '      headers.forEach(h => {',
  '        h.textContent = h.getAttribute("data-title") + " ↕";',
  '      });',
  '      th.textContent = th.getAttribute("data-title") + (asc ? " ▲" : " ▼");',
  '      asc = !asc;',
  '    });',
  '  });',
  '}',
  'makeTableSortable("schoolRosterTable");',
  '</script>'
))
```
